title: The Sandlot
pitch: One summer, one baseball team, one legendary beast behind the fence. You're killing me, Smalls!

title: Home Alone
pitch: Kevin's family flies to Paris and forgets HIM. Two burglars are about to meet the greatest trap-builder of all time.

title: The Iron Giant
pitch: A boy finds a 50-foot robot from space. You are who you choose to be.

title: Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory
pitch: Five golden tickets, one mysterious chocolate factory, and a test almost nobody passes.

title: Hook
pitch: What if Peter Pan grew up, forgot everything, and had to become Peter Pan again? Bangarang!

title: The NeverEnding Story
pitch: A boy opens a book and the story starts reading HIM. A luck dragon, a nothing, and a new name.

title: The Wizard of Oz
pitch: Dorothy opens a door and the whole world turns to color. A yellow brick road, a wicked witch, and three friends who need a brain, a heart, and courage.

title: Toy Story
pitch: What do your toys do when you leave the room? Woody and Buzz find out they need each other. To infinity and beyond!

title: Mary Poppins
pitch: A nanny floats in on an umbrella, jumps into a chalk painting, and has tea on the ceiling. Practically perfect in every way.

title: The Karate Kid
pitch: Wax on, wax off. The new kid gets picked on until a quiet handyman teaches him karate in the strangest way possible.

title: Babe
pitch: A little pig decides he wants to be a sheepdog. Everyone laughs, except the sheep. That'll do, pig.

title: My Neighbor Totoro
pitch: Two sisters move to the countryside and meet a giant, fluffy forest spirit at a rainy bus stop. A movie with no bad guy at all.

title: The Incredibles
pitch: A family of superheroes has to hide their powers, until the world needs them. Where is my super suit?

title: Star Wars
pitch: A farm boy, a princess, a smuggler, and a walking carpet take on an empire. The one that started it all.

title: The Lion King
pitch: A lion cub who cannot wait to be king runs from his biggest mistake, then comes home to face it. Hakuna matata.

title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
pitch: A professor with a whip and a hat races the bad guys to a lost treasure. Snakes. Why did it have to be snakes?

title: Ghostbusters
pitch: Who you gonna call? Four scientists in a beat-up ambulance catch ghosts all over New York, until a giant marshmallow man shows up.
